production_shipped_result.note: AUTHORITATIVE -- measured against the actual shipped production code (reclaim.ai.image_embeddings + semantic_image_grouping), PIL-only preprocessing (no torchvision, since torch is no longer a dependency), fp16 ONNX model. Same 40-block/98-image real Copydays subset, same BCubed methodology, same shipped 0.82 threshold. Reproduced twice independently (scratch validation script and the production module itself) with identical results.
production_shipped_result.delta_attributed_to: preprocessing reimplementation (PIL bicubic+reducing_gap vs torchvision antialiased bicubic), NOT model quantization -- the model conversion itself was proven bit-identical BCubed behavior (see conversion_only_measurement below) when preprocessing was held constant. This residual drift is unavoidable given torch/torchvision are no longer a dependency (ANY torch-free ONNX approach, int8 or fp16, needs some non-torchvision resize), not specific to the fp16 choice.
production_shipped_result.still_clears_track_b_precision_floor: 0.7720 > 0.70 (Track B's own stated 'looser precision bar, browse-tidiness not deletion suggestion' floor from evals/test_ai_semantic_grouping_gold.py)

conversion_only_measurement.note: Earlier measurement using the ORIGINAL torchvision preprocessing pipeline for both backends (isolates model-quantization-only effect from the preprocessing-reimplementation effect above). Not what ships -- kept for the record to show quantization vs preprocessing contributions separately.

production_with_int8_for_comparison.note: Production-shaped (PIL) preprocessing + int8 model, for completeness -- confirms int8 is worse than fp16 under BOTH preprocessing pipelines, not just the original one.

decision: SHIP CLIP AS FP16. int8 rejected under both preprocessing pipelines (delta_f1 -0.041 with torchvision preprocessing, -0.019 with production PIL preprocessing) -- consistently worse than fp16 (delta_f1 0.000 / -0.008 respectively) by roughly 2x. fp16 remains comfortably above Track B's 0.70 precision floor in the actual shipped configuration.
